title: Toy-Doll Travel Escape
source: 2026 big-game spot: a groomed toy doll books a getaway in a travel app
description: A deadpan toy-miniature comedy: a narrator 'voice in the sky' answers a plastic-perfect doll hero as he books, packs and hops through postcard destination vignettes, ending on a rewards gag and an aerial end card.
prompt30: Make a 30 s toy-miniature comedy for our new travel app 'Wandr': a perfectly groomed doll hero books a trip, a deadpan narrator answers him from the sky, quick postcard vignettes, a rewards-paid rental car gag, and our tagline 'Go further for less.' on the end card.
